g.text: Incident coordination between the parties: who notifies whom, and the clocks
GDPR Art. 33 and 34, NIS2 Art. 23 as transposed (BSIG), Regulation (EU) 2025/327 Art. 63, 64 and 73
Detect and contain: the first hour
Notify: the clocks run in parallel
Bold messages are the legal clocks. Each is owned by a role: the controller owns the
GDPR ones, the operator the NIS2 ones, the access body the EHDS ones. The incident
procedure names a person and a deputy for every lifeline; the tabletop exercise
before go-live walks this diagram once.
